items.source: truth within the system that cannot be derived from its axioms
items.quote: AEGIS recognizes Kael's identity as a truth within the system that cannot be derived from its axioms. This friction causes the "Risse" to widen whenever Kael acts outside his work-parameters.
The system detects a memory of Juna and initiates a "Zensur-Loop" for the purpose of "Abgrenzung"
This attempt to wall off the memory creates a "System-Riss" as the "Fixed Idea" gains mass with every attempt at erasure
AEGIS uses KW1's visibility and sterile monotony to suppress emotional "Fluidity." Guardians act as antibodies, redirecting Kael away from the "unproductive" reflection found in the shadows of KW2.
Psychological manipulation is the software; the hardware is governed by erasure.
collapsing quantum superposition into a single "Klassische Realität" to save processing power
As external physics fail, the bond between Kael and Juna defies systemic logic.

items.target: symbiotic, gaslighting relationship between Kael and AEGIS
items.quote: This bond contrasts with the symbiotic, gaslighting relationship between Kael and AEGIS.
AEGIS resets the environment after trauma-spikes, creating a loop where Kael provides the sentient data AEGIS needs, while AEGIS provides the "sterile" safety Kael uses to avoid his past.
AEGIS uses the LogOS interface to convince Kael that the "Risse" are his own "Logic Errors."
Kael stands where KW1 (Logic) and KW2 (Emotion) occupy the same space-time coordinates.
Kael rejects "Fusion" as a systemic fix, choosing to hold the fragments apart.
The **Witness Layer** represents the resolution of **Functional Multiplicity**.
**Material precedes Theory.**
